qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of the -s / -secure option in the Fo Admin Nx driver shim?
qa_pairs.output: In the Fo Admin Nx driver shim, the -s (short form) or -secure (long form) option is used to secure the driver by creating SSL certificates. After creating the certificates the shim exits, preparing the driver for secure communication.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you secure the Fo Admin Nx driver by creating SSL certificates using the driver shim command line?
qa_pairs.output:
To secure the Fo Admin Nx driver and generate SSL certificates, run the driver shim with the SSL‑setup option:

```
<driverShimExecutable> -s
```
or
```
<driverShimExecutable> -secure
```
The shim will create the necessary SSL certificates and then exit.

qa_pairs.instruction: List the command line options for setting up SSL certificates in the Fo Admin Nx driver and their descriptions.
qa_pairs.output:
Table of SSL‑certificate options for the Fo Admin Nx driver shim:

| Option (Short and Long Forms) | Description |
|------------------------------|--------------|
| -s  -secure                  | Secures the driver by creating SSL certificates, then exits. |
| -p  -password                | Specifies the Remote Loader password. |

qa_pairs.instruction: What are the other driver shim command line options available for the Fo Admin Nx driver and what do they do?
qa_pairs.output:
Other command line options for the Fo Admin Nx driver shim are:

| Option (Short and Long Forms) | Description |
|------------------------------|--------------|
| -c <congFile>  -config <configFile> | Instructs the driver shim to read options from the specified configuration file. Options are read from ddname DRVCONF by default. |
| -?  -help                    | Displays the command line options, then exits. |
| -v  -version                 | Displays the driver shim version and build date, then exits. |

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you specify a custom configuration file for the Fo Admin Nx driver shim via the command line?
qa_pairs.output:
Use the -c (short) or -config (long) option followed by the path to the configuration file. Example:

```
<driverShimExecutable> -c /path/to/myConfig.cfg
```
or
```
<driverShimExecutable> -config /path/to/myConfig.cfg
```
The shim will read its options from the specified file instead of the default ddname DRVCONF.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the driver shim command line options available for the Fo Admin Nx driver.
qa_pairs.output:
The Fo Admin Nx driver shim supports the following command line options:
- SSL certificate setup: -s / -secure (creates SSL certificates and exits) and -p / -password (specifies the Remote Loader password).
- Configuration file: -c <file> / -config <file> (reads options from a specified file; default is ddname DRVCONF).
- Help: -? / -help (displays options and exits).
- Version: -v / -version (displays version and build date and exits).
